# Copilot Instructions for cpp-computer-access-controller

## Project Overview
This is a C++ computer access controller project. When working with this codebase, follow these guidelines:

## Language and Style
- This is a C++ project
- Follow modern C++ best practices (C++11 or later)
- Use RAII principles for resource management
- Prefer smart pointers over raw pointers when appropriate

## Code Structure
- Keep code modular and well-organized
- Use header files (.h or .hpp) for declarations
- Use source files (.cpp) for implementations

## Naming Conventions
- Use clear, descriptive names for variables, functions, and classes
- Follow consistent naming conventions throughout the codebase
- Use camelCase for variables and functions, PascalCase for classes

## Build and Testing
- Ensure any changes compile without warnings
- Add appropriate error handling
- Consider edge cases and validate inputs

## Documentation
- Document complex logic with clear comments
- Keep the README.md updated with any significant changes
- Document public APIs and interfaces

## Security
- Handle access control logic with care
- Validate all inputs
- Consider security implications of any changes
